products.name: Splice
products.note: Mobile video editing; music licensing; content creation; GoPro ownership

profile_text.body:
Splice describes itself as a royalty-free sample library, offering access to millions of sounds made by artists, labels, and sound designers. Its core catalog covers samples, sound effects, and presets, and it hosts a plugin called the Sounds Plugin that integrates directly into a digital audio workstation, allowing users to search, preview, and drag and drop sounds without leaving their project. The company also offers a mobile app, Splice Mobile, which lets users record and develop song ideas on the go and export stems to a DAW or share them with collaborators. A partnership with Xfer Records is highlighted on the site, featuring Xfer's wavetable synthesizer with updated features and workflow enhancements.

The held facts classify Splice under video generation and editing, noting associations with mobile video editing, music licensing, content creation, and GoPro ownership, though the company's own site focuses squarely on audio, samples, and music production tools. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held data.
